def load() -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = pd.read_csv('data/legal/input/csn-data-book-2024-csv/CSVs/2024_CSN_Number_of_Reports_by_Type.csv', header=0)
    df.columns = ['Year', 'Fraud', 'Identity Theft', 'Other']

    df['Year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Year'], errors='coerce')
    df = df.dropna(subset=['Year'])
    df['Identity Theft'] = df['Identity Theft'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '').astype(int)
    return df
